title: Chapter 6248: Destroyed

Chapter 6248: Destroyed

Chapter 6248: Destroyed

"Ancestor!" Li Xian recognized her due to the blade stuck in her chest.

She was none other than Li Xuansu but the survivors didn't recognize this once-famous progenitor.

Ye Sha noticed her and roared in response, releasing a pulse of divinity. Stars exploded instantly.

She opened her eyes and gathered the power of the galaxy, becoming blindingly bright. Before this, the world was dark due to Ye Sha's overwhelming fog.

Now, her celestial light made it look like daytime once more. She raised her hand, the start of a technique.

It gathered all laws between heaven and earth. Her fate palaces rotated and summoned a primal anima. Everything was within her grasp, whether it be dao power, worldly essences, or the yin and yang...

Cultivators became trapped like insects in a spiderweb and had their powers taken.

"Bam!" She performed a vertical palm strike against Ye Sha.

"Boom!" An unending chasm appeared in front of her, looking like the apocalypse.

Ancestors immediately fled with all of their might, crossing through dimensions. Alas, not all could escape the explosions.

"Ahh!" As they were flying away, they saw fellow cultivators screaming and dying. This only made them run faster.

Unfortunately, the impact waves were too fast and caught up to them in no time at all, putting an end to many lives.

"Whoosh!" Ye Sha was sent flying but in the next second, it appeared above Li Xuansu.

"Raa!" It flapped its wings and focused on her alone, shattering the fabrics of reality and creating a terrifying maelstrom spanning ten million miles.

"We're gonna die!" Lucky survivors shouted after witnessing Ye Sha's power.

"Boom!" The black fog came together in its claw, turning into the might of a true dragon. A world of divine beasts in the form of a beam came smashing down against the progenitor.

Xuansu reacted swiftly and sealed the sky, ready to slay this dragon. Alas, those below still screamed in horror.

"Bam!" Despite her defense, it still struck the continent and created a crater.

"This continent will go down again!" People were too afraid to run after seeing the size of the crater. They thought that she was dead from the attack.

"Clank!" Two black chains came out of the crater and aimed for Ye Sha.

The powerful big shots could see two buckles attached to the creature below its wings. The chains immediately latched against the buckles and tightened up.

"Clank!" It began pulling the powerful creature downward.

"Raa!" It roared but resistance seemed futile. The other end of the two chains seemed to be part of the earth itself.

Everyone saw it being pulled down slowly regardless of its attempts at breaking free. Eventually, it disappeared into the crater.

"It's over?" The crowd couldn't regain their composure.

That battle just now exceeded anything they had seen before. Ancestors were as weak as insects. Just the shockwaves alone could have obliterated them.

"Is it okay now?" Everyone became afraid.

Fortunately, nothing happened and Ye Sha's roars could no longer be heard. Some brave souls started heading for the crater.

Not long ago, the continent healed wonderfully and had a bright future. Now, the battle between Ye Sha and Xuansu destroyed half of the continent.

The crater was bottomless, penetrated deep enough to see the other side of space.

"Look down there!" Someone shouted.

"Is... is this a divine tree?" Spectators became confused.

There was no sign of Ye Sha or the woman, only another colossal entity.
